about: The only call sites allowed to make a paid Jev call, read by ops/typesafe_client.py before any transport. An unregistered caller, a call without the site's attribution, or a site marked unattended=off inside a CARR_JEV_WORKER=off worker is refused and logged, never paid. Budgets are per UTC hour and per UTC day per site, under hourly_paid_call_cap and jev-cost-guard's daily_paid_call_cap. `caller` is the module that called ask()/judge() (file name without .py) or an explicit caller= string. A new paid call path fails ops/jev-call-sites-selftest.py until it has an entry here. Audit and per-site decisions: the 2026-10-04 PR 'Jev: system-wide call audit, call-site registry and budgets'. `transport_sources` names every tracked file that dispatches a paid Jev transport (the vendor endpoint, or ask-jev through callTool, run.sh or local-verb) and the control its source implements: shared_admission (this registry plus the shared reservation before dispatch), worker_reservation_proof (the Worker verifies and consumes a signed admission), worker_runtime_class (an in-Worker caller under the app_runtime class, which ingress cannot select). The selftest fails on an unlisted transport and on a label whose control is absent from its source. A caller outside this repository that reaches the Worker is refused without an admission; one that calls the vendor directly is outside what this registry can see.
